summary: Gibraltar Industries filed an 8-K disclosing that subsidiary D.S.B. Holding Corp. agreed to sell all capital stock of The D.S. Brown Company to GCP Applied Technologies Inc., an affiliate of Saint-Gobain, for $208.0 million cash, subject to working capital, debt, cash and transaction-expense adjustments. The October 14, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement requires HSR antitrust clearance, no injunction and customary closing conditions; no Gibraltar stockholder vote is needed. Closing is expected before year-end 2026, with an outside date of January 31, 2027 and up to five 30-day automatic extensions. Watch HSR timing and regulatory risk.
